name: Collateral 1
definition: Provides details about the collateral against variation margin and optionally the segregated independent amount.

VariationMargin.name: Variation Margin
VariationMargin.definition: Provides details about the collateral held, in transit or that still needs to be agreed by both parties, against the variation margin.

SegregatedIndependentAmount.name: Segregated Independent Amount
SegregatedIndependentAmount.definition: Provides details about the collateral held, in transit or that still needs to be agreed by both parties, against the segregated independent amount.
